seo_title: B2B Master Data Management (MDM) Architecture | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Duplicate data and billing errors? We design Master Data Management (MDM) architectures to unify your B2B company's databases and eradicate dirty data.
author_pitch: As a Database Architect, I see companies lose millions by having the same information fragmented across five different systems. Designing a database is not just creating tables; it is imposing order. I build the 'Single Source of Truth' to eradicate ghost data and duplicate billing.
title: The duplicate data chaos: MDM architecture to unify your B2B company
body:
Is your company losing money on failed shipments and incorrect invoices because the same client appears triplicated in different systems?

As your B2B corporation grows, acquires new software, or absorbs other companies, information becomes fragmented. The sales department registers a client in the CRM, logistics has them in the ERP with a different address, and accounting issues invoices to a third company name in their financial software. This database asymmetry generates massive operational chaos: shipments are lost, financial reports do not match, and employees waste hours a day reconciling information by hand to find out which data is correct.

The trap of Point-to-Point Synchronizations

The classic mistake is trying to connect the CRM directly to the ERP, and the ERP to accounting using small scripts or basic third-party integrators. Creating a cobweb of patched integrations between isolated systems guarantees massive data corruption at the first network failure.

Our solution: Master Data Management (MDM) Architecture

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we eradicate dirty data. We design and implement a custom central Master Data Management (MDM) system. We build a single master database that acts as the heart of your company, dictating the authorized information to all other peripheral systems in real time.

  1. Data Cleansing and Auditing: We crawl all your current databases to identify duplicates, resolve record conflicts, and merge fragmented profiles into unique identities.
  2. Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Modeling: We design a hyper-optimized central database that stores the definitive and validated version of your clients, products, and suppliers.
  3. Governance and Routing Rules: We program logical flows so that if a salesperson updates a phone number in the CRM, the MDM system validates the data and automatically propagates it to the ERP and accounting.
  4. Traceability and Version Control: We implement an immutable historical record (Data Lineage) so you can audit exactly which user, when, and from which system modified a critical data point.

The Real Impact on your Corporate Operations

  • Eradication of Logistic and Financial Errors: By operating with unified and clean data, you eliminate invoices issued to incorrect addresses and shipments returned due to outdated information.
  • Precise Analytical Visibility: Your executives will finally be able to trust Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, basing their decisions on 100% accurate corporate metrics.
  • Acceleration in Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A): Your software architecture will be ready to easily integrate the databases of newly acquired companies without corrupting your operational core.
